Session 12 Prep: The Key and the Wall

Continues from: Session 11 Summary Arc: end of Phase 5 (The Princess and the Dragon); start of Phase 6 (The Evil Queen's Reckoning) Estimated Length: 2 hours 50 minutes including a 10-minute break; finish at the GM's 5 p.m. hard stop. Asset Checklist: @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.7c942240b293606f]{session12 asset checklist} What comes after: @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.fa6597afb86e582d]{rosehold runbook} · @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.cde61798bfdf1c71]{Rosehold} · @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.168a20ce123acb41]{rosehold tracker} · rosehold asset list

1. Where Session 11 Left Off

Filly, Vega and Tawny are at the knight camp in the south of the Scorchwoods, led there by Pippin's compass. Nothing at the camp has been played. Marigold stayed with Princess Amy at the cave and is fully healed (GM ruling 2026-10-05). The cave's force field is back up. The hunt clock is retired. All three PCs are at Dragonfilch Curse stage one and know the cure. The GM has promised level 4 on saving Amy.

GM plan for this session: the party fights Embra's party at the camp, and that ends The Princess and the Dragon.

Party status copied from campaign state

PC Player Gift Current carry-forward
Princess Filly skeptica Wild Heart Rides Tawny (silver claws). Owns the Lunar Grotto Spear (d8), Dewdrop Elixir of Invisibility, Swan's Grace Pendant, Spectacles of Discernment, and a few crystal dragon teeth. Befuddled since the orchard. Dragonfilch Curse stage one.
Prince Vega spyro01 Elemental Connection (earth/stone) Wields Vein-Breaker and Blitzenaxt. Carries Heartstone, the Ring of Heart, and a piece of crystal dragon horn and bone. Keeps the party's silver tally: 260 SP. Dragonfilch Curse stage one.
Princess Marigold 11de784a Healing Touch Absent from session 11; waited with Amy at the cave and is fully healed. Staff of the Sunken Sanctum, silver dagger, Dragonfire Shield (at carry limit). Dragonfilch Curse stage one.

Carried and relevant today: Pippins Princess Compass (points at Amy's body, so at Embra); the @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.64b7a41a41e7c4b2]{pins} (point at Amy herself); Bran's net and fishing pole; Mari Lwyd's Teeth; 2 Corruption Cures; Amulet of the Forest Guardian (2 GD). Marigold's player missed session 11: she does not yet know the cure, the compass, or the Raphael alliance.

Exact HP, dice, charges and money live in Foundry.

Before opening

  • [ ] Populate the Knight Camp scene. It was empty last week. Carriage, Finnian, Robin, 8 guards, 3 attendants, Embra labelled Princess Amy, a black tent.

  • [ ] Update the companion module in the world (0.6.0 was never installed; session 11 found the gaps).

  • [ ] Clear Filly's stale 5/13 HP and Woozy; she is Befuddled only.

  • [ ] Have each player's level 4 changes ready to apply mid-session (scene 5).

  • [ ] Ask Marigold's player, privately, what was in the diary she bought back at the Night Market. It matters in the castle.

2. Session Flow Cheat Sheet

SESSION 12 — THE KEY AND THE WALL                        170 minutes
ACT I: THE CAMP
  1. Word from the gnomes; Marigold rides in             15 min
  2. The Magnificent Objection (parley)                  20 min
  3. Battle at the Knight Camp                           45 min
  4. The Black Tent; the road to the cave                10 min
  ☕ BREAK                                               10 min
ACT II: THE KEY
  5. The Key Turns (swap, LEVEL 4, Embra's reckoning)    35 min
  6. Knighthoods and Level Four                          15 min
ACT III: NORTH
  7. The Muster Below Rosehold                           20 min

Total: 170 minutes. If the camp fight runs long, cut scene 6 to five minutes and end at the cave; open session 13 with the muster.

Spotlight opportunities

  • ⭐ Filly: talks the mule line loose; pins a floating princess to a tree with a spear; first Wild Form; the muster is made of animals she saved.

  • ⭐ Vega: reads the red mud in the black tent; the cave is his element; names his elemental; manners with Finnian.

  • ⭐ Marigold: returns with Scamp and Amy's message; the Dragonfire Shield eats Embra's fireball and throws it back; Smooch ends the chase; her staff pulls toward the wall.

5. GM Tools

The one rule for the camp

Embra must not die in Amy's body. Pippin's note says it; say it again if needed. Consequences if she does are in scene 3.

d6 camp complications (use one if the fight is flat)

d6 Complication
1 A guard recognises the Silver Rose pin: "My sister's in the Society!" He stops fighting.
2 The carriage horses bolt with an attendant still on the box.
3 A tent catches from the cook-fire. Smoke: ranged attacks have disadvantage for two rounds.
4 Robin stands in front of Finnian with a wooden sword and will not move.
5 Lady Stella's twins, Diana and Beck, come back from hunting, see the fight, and ask which side is which. Whoever answers best has them.
6 A cursed PC sees the pay chest spill open. WITS test or lose a turn scooping silver.

d10 camp whispers

Use @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.95f00957202cd8a0]{Whisper Table}. Best for today: 1 ("It doesn't matter if she's been acting strangely. She's the princess."), 5 (Damon), 6 (the hooded fellow), 8 (don't take the dragon's treasure).

6. Handout Prep

No handouts to prepare (GM direction 2026-10-05). Read these aloud from their scene notes instead:

  • Pippin's note (scene 1). The one fact the players must hear: both wearers alive.

  • The paper under the thorn (scene 4). First appearance of M. and ROSEHOLD.

  • Ally Calls (scene 7): the table in @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.a1d4390573d3737d]{Ally Calls} is player-safe if you want to paste it into chat.

Do not share the runbook, the level notes, or any _gm floor plan.

7. Potential Session End Points

  1. ⭐ Recommended: Amy's hands on the ice. Embra dealt with, level 4 applied, calls chosen, way in chosen.
  2. If the fight and the cave take the evening: end on the knighting, or on Aurelius's arrival. Open session 13 with the muster.
  3. If the party bargains at the camp and there is no fight: the session runs short. Play the muster in full and run the Barrier set piece (@UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.cf5d4639928d11ad]{00 The Thornwall}, A2–A3); end at the gatehouse.
  4. If Embra dies at the camp: stop after scene 4. Re-plan with the fallback in scene 3 before next week.

At close record: how each curse ended and which items each PC still holds; whether Embra and Finnian are alive and where; level 4 rolls (HP, Virtues); Filly's agreed Wild Form list; Vega's elemental's name; the six Ally Calls; the chosen way in.
